description.en:
The winch rope can be attached to the attacher joints of other vehicles, not only to trees and logs: to pull a stuck tractor out, to drag a trailer by its drawbar eye, to move a vehicle a few metres without driving it.
Use the winch as usual: stand at it, start the attach mode, and look at an attacher joint of a vehicle (a tractor's hitch, a trailer's eye). The green ring shows the joint, and the attach key ties the rope to it. The winch's own limits apply (maximum mass, rope length).
The hand winch (hand tools, miscellaneous, in the shop) does it without a winch vehicle: hook onto a joint, walk away, and the vehicle creeps after you at 2 km/h, to move something a few metres. Works with every winch in the game, also the ones of other mods. Single player only. Console command wtProbe lists the attacher joints near where you look.
